hooks.text: Our Sun and entire galaxy are being pulled across space.
Over 8,000 galaxies are dragging our Milky Way across space.
The cosmic puller pulling our Milky Way is being pulled too.

title: The Cosmic Monster Dragging Our Entire Galaxy
description: Astronomers long blamed the Great Attractor for pulling our Milky Way, but a far larger titan is hauling everything across space: the Shapley Supercluster.

beats.text: Our Sun and entire galaxy are being pulled across space.
beats.visual: Illustration of the Milky Way galaxy moving through deep space

beats.text: Astronomers thought a local pull called the Great Attractor was responsible.
beats.visual: Diagram showing the Great Attractor pulling nearby galaxies

beats.text: But that mysterious cosmic anchor's getting dragged along with us.
beats.visual: Illustration of galactic motion vectors across the universe

beats.text: The real titan sits 650 million light-years away in Centaurus.
beats.visual: Sky chart of the constellation Centaurus

beats.text: The Shapley Supercluster packs over 8,000 whole galaxies together.
beats.visual: Composite image of the Shapley Supercluster core from ROSAT

beats.text: Its total mass exceeds ten million billion Suns combined.
beats.visual: Photograph of galaxy cluster Abell 3558 inside Shapley Supercluster

beats.text: It is the most massive structure within a billion light-years.
beats.visual: Diagram of cosmic web structures surrounding the Shapley Supercluster
queries: Cosmic web large scale structure diagram

beats.text: Because right now, this monster is reeling our world across the dark.
beats.visual: Artist's illustration of galactic gravitational attraction across deep space
